1445-4871-6798-8347.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-4871-6798-8347.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Sela triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

803-5686-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
803-5686-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Arcane Adaptation, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Arcane Adaptation, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability, creating a Blood token.
Repeat from step 3.

1395-5078-5295-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska and Elsha's prowess ability trigger.
Resolve the Elsha trigger, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn
Resolve the Vraska trigger, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

206-1661-5078-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

728-2425-6249--5.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Smothering Abomination trigger.
Resolve the Smothering Abomination trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

765-5414-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Guildless Commons.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing Guildless Commons.
When Guildless Commons dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Guildless Commons from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Guildless Commons enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Troubled Healer ability
Repeat.

1512-2034-2178.description:
Activate Stonybrook Schoolmaster using the ability granted to it by Thornbite Staff by paying {2} and tapping it.
Stonybrook Schoolmaster triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Stonybrook Schoolmaster ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Stonybrook Schoolmaster triggers, untapping Stonybrook Schoolmaster.
Repeat.

1274-5641-6890-7810.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-5641-6890-7810.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token and an artifact token.
When the artifact token enters the battlefield, Arbaaz Mir triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to each opponent
Repeat from step 2.

as a copy of Radiant Solar

624-670-1619-3680.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
624-670-1619-3680.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Stunt Double and Phantasmal Image each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Stunt Double trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Phantasmal Image trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
624-670-1619-3680.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

1245-1475-2486.notablePrerequisites: You control two additional creatures excluding the creature that has One with the Kami attached to it, at least one of which must be modified.
1245-1475-2486.description:
Activate Tooth and Claw by sacrificing two other creatures.
When the creatures die, One with the Kami triggers for each modified creature that died this way, creating a number of 1/1 Spirit creature tokens that each enter with a +1/+1 counter on them due to Master Chef.
Resolve the Tooth and Claw ability, creating a 3/1 Carnivore creature token that enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Master Chef.
Repeat.

792-1580-4871-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Totentanz trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

206-215-4188.notablePrerequisites: You have gained at least 6 life this turn.
206-215-4188.description:
Activate Accomplished Alchemist by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Accomplished Alchemist from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Accomplished Alchemist by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

141-413-7449.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard with mana value 4 or less.
141-413-7449.description:
Cast Stir the Grave by paying {4}{B}.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Stir the Grave
Resolve the Stir the Grave copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1061-7334-7393.easyPrerequisites: You control a Shard that doesn't have summoning sickness.
1061-7334-7393.notablePrerequisites:
You have the city's blessing.
An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
1061-7334-7393.description:
Activate Niko by paying {2} and tapping it, exiling Timestream Navigator and causing Shards you control to become a copy of Timestream Navigator until the end step.
Activate a Shard by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it and putting it from the battlefield onto the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Declare The Neutrinos as an attacker. It triggers, blinking Niko.
When Niko enters, it triggers, creating two Shard tokens.
At the beginning of the next end step, Timestream Navigator is returned from exile to the battlefield. The Neutrinos then triggers, blinking Niko.
Repeat each turn.

6824-7362.notablePrerequisites:
Casey has lifelink.
You have a way to gain life.
6824-7362.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Casey.
Casey triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent and causing you to gain 1 life due to its lifelink.
Repeat from step 2.

4311-5078-7356.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Longshot triggers, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Repeat

5686-5687-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
5686-5687-7084.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Skittering Precursor and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Skittering Precursor trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.
5686-5687-7084.notes: You can instead sacrifice the creature tokens to their own abilities instead of sacrificing them to Shilgengar.

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

4742-5299-5921-5970--112.notablePrerequisites:
Mirror Room is locked.
Fractured Realm is unlocked.
4742-5299-5921-5970--112.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, creating a token copy of Marina.
Put the tapped Marina into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Marina token enters the battlefield, it's first ability triggers twice, causing you to look at the top seven cards of your library and put all enchantment cards from among them into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library, and then repeat this once.
Resolve the second Mirror Room trigger, creating a token copy of itself, as it is a creature due to Opalescence.
Activate the Marina token by tapping it, unlocking the token Mirror Room.
Repeat from step 2.
4742-5299-5921-5970--112.notes: The chosen anthem must increase the toughness of the Mirror Room token so it does not die as it enters the battlefield.

2308-4871-5070-5231.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain any amount of life.
2308-4871-5070-5231.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
When the Fungus Beast enters, Angelic Chorus triggers.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Fungus Beast, adding {R}.
When the Fungus Beast dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Holding priority, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Angelic Chorus trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

3941-4331-4985-4993.description:
Activate Coveted Jewel by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Manifold Key by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Coveted Jewel.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Manifold Key from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Manifold Key by paying {0}.
Repeat.

2919-3490-4716-5231.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2919-3490-4716-5231.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Prosperous Innkeeper triggers, causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the Archangel of Thune trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

3169-3179-4050-6992.notablePrerequisites: You control a number of creatures equal to or greater than 6 plus Leonardo's commander tax, if applicable.
3169-3179-4050-6992.description:
Cast Leonardo either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W} due to its cost reduction.
Oketra's Monument triggers, creating a creature token.
When Leonardo enters, Genesis Chamber triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Leonardo, adding {W}.
Put Leonardo into the command zone from your graveyard.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

628-4050-6972.easyPrerequisites: You control another nontoken non-Human creature with base toughness 2 or greater.
628-4050-6972.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another nontoken non-Human creature
When the creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When the creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Repeat.
628-4050-6972.notes: If the creature being used starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

3259-5768-6968.notablePrerequisites:
Origin of the Hidden Ones has exactly two lore counters on it.
You control at least one Assassin that does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-5768-6968.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Origin of the Hidden Ones triggers, putting a lore counter on it.
Origin of the Hidden Ones' third chapter ability triggers, causing you to create an Assassin token whenever an Assassin attacks this turn and sacrifice Origin of the Hidden Ones.
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached, and at least one Assassin if the creature with Breath of Fury attached isn't an Assassin, as attackers.
Origin of the Hidden Ones triggers, creating a 1/1 Assassin creature token that's tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Assassin token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

3755-4222-6936.description:
Activate Goblin Medics by tapping it, adding {U}.
Goblin Medics triggers, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Goblin Medics.
Repeat.

1976-4311-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

813-4872-5530.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana available each turn to cast Time Warp and Another Round.
813-4872-5530.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Another Round by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Warp and Another Round from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

372-3742-4200.notablePrerequisites:
Icewind Stalwart exiled by Abdel Adrian.
You have enough mana to cast Phantom Steed.
372-3742-4200.description:
Cast Phantom Steed by paying its mana cost.
When Phantom Steed enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Abdel Adrian until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, causing Icewind Stalwart to return to the battlefield from exile.
When Icewind Stalwart enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Phantom Steed.
Phantom Steed leaves and enters the battlefield, causing Abdel Adrian to return to the battlefield from exile and triggering Abdel Adrian and Phantom Steed.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Icewind Stalwart and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, exiling Abdel Adrian until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

198-2225-3767-3918.manaNeeded: {1} if Trazyn doesn't have a charge counter on it
198-2225-3767-3918.easyPrerequisites: Trazyn the Infinite does not have summoning sickness.
198-2225-3767-3918.description:
Activate Trazyn using Empowered Autogenerator's ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on Trazyn and adding one mana of any color for each charge counter on Trazyn.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.

4559-4772-5686.notablePrerequisites: The total mana value of noncreature artifacts you control is at least 11.
4559-4772-5686.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus, creating two Blood tokens.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Bloods, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

527-2438-5140.manaNeeded: {G}, plus {R} if Selvala has summoning sickness
527-2438-5140.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 7 or greater that isn't Selvala.
527-2438-5140.description:
If Selvala has summoning sickness, activate Kenrith's first ability by paying {R}, giving all creatures haste until end of turn.
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {4}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Selvala, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder.
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {4}{B}, returning Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
527-2438-5140.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

2393-3944-5258-5618.description:
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it, adding {B}.
When Blood Pet dies, Sifter of Skulls and Rakdos trigger.
Resolve the Sifter of Skulls trigger, creating a 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature token.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Blood Pet from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile Blood Pet from the top of your library with the ability to play it until your next end step.
Activate the Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Cast Blood Pet from exile by paying {1}.
Repeat.

261-1339-4279.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You control at least one additional creature.
261-1339-4279.description:
Activate Yawgmoth's first ability by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature, causing you to draw a card and allowing you to put a -1/-1 counter on up to one creature.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Suture Priest triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

141-1223-2034.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one creature on the battlefield.
141-1223-2034.description:
Cast Fake Your Own Death by paying {1}{B}, targeting any creature.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Fake Your Own Death, targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Fake Your Own Death.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Naru Meha, adding {C}{C}.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield and creating a Treasure token.
Repeat from step 3.

1339-2034-5572.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1339-2034-5572.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Dragon Appeasement triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Repeat.

24-220-2191.description:
Cast Martyrdom by paying {1}{W}{W}, targeting Brash Taunter.
Cast Wheel of Misfortune by paying {2}{R}.
Holding priority, activate Brash Taunter's ability from Martyrdom any number of times by paying {0}, causing any amount of damage that would be dealt to you to be dealt to Brash Taunter instead this turn.
Resolve Wheel of Misfortune, choosing an arbitrarily large number and dealing an arbitrarily large amount of damage to the targeted creature and to Brash Taunter.
Brash Taunter triggers, targeting an opponent.
Holding priority, activate Brash Taunter's ability from Martyrdom many times by paying {0}, causing the next large amount of damage that would be dealt to the targeted opponent to be dealt to Brash Taunter instead this turn.
Resolve Brash Taunter's ability, redirecting some of the damage back to Brash Taunter but still dealing lethal damage to the opponent.
Repeat from step 5 once for each remaining opponent.

1356-1806-2034-3002-3490.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eternal Scourge, adding {C}{C}.
Eternal Scourge is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard due to Rest in Reace.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Rocco triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control and creating a Food artifact token.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

914-3719-4050.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least three artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-3719-4050.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least four Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist, adding {B}.
Activate Ruthless Technomancer by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing a Treasure token, returning Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1232-3430-4289-5295.description:
Activate Nemata by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Nemata's first ability by paying {2}{G}, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate the Saproling by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

1315-1850-4482.description:
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing a land.
Play the land from your graveyard.
Repeat.
1315-1850-4482.notes: If the land can tap for mana once it enters the battlefield, you can do so for infinite mana.

2228-2741-4279-4772.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You control another creature.
2228-2741-4279-4772.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, putting a -1/-1 counter on an opponent's creature and drawing a card.
Hapatra triggers, creating two 1/1 Snake creature tokens.
The Snakes enter the battlefield, triggering Essence Warden twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat until your opponent control no creatures.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, putting two -1/-1 counters on a Snake token you control and drawing a card.
The Snake dies as a state-based action due to having less than 1 toughness.
Hapatra triggers, creating two 1/1 Snake creature tokens.
The Snakes enter the battlefield, triggering Essence Warden twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat from step 5.
